diagnosis: The SmartLockResource serializes the device's pre-shared AES master key and factory override PIN whenever a mobile client requests the lock status. Any tenant or guest granted temporary unlock permissions can inspect API responses to harvest static cryptographic keys and permanently compromise physical lock security.
